title.en: Compassionate and highly attentive clinical team

text.en: Clients consistently praise Dr. Vivian Leung and clinic manager Heather for their warmth, deep professional knowledge, and individualized approach to veterinary medicine. Pet owners appreciate Dr. Leung's patient listening, thorough explanations of medical diagnoses, and multilingual communication skills. Reviewers frequently note that the staff never rush appointments or pressure owners into unnecessary tests.

Pet guardians commend the hospital's calm environment and gentle handling of sensitive, elderly, and nervous animals. Reviewers describe how dogs and cats felt relaxed during visits, with staff members offering patient comfort rather than overwhelming pets with treats. Owners of senior dogs with chronic health conditions highlight that their companions received dedicated and thoughtful care.

Reviewers report positive medical outcomes for complex conditions, surgical interventions, and ongoing chronic ailments. Pet owners highlight successful emergency foreign object removal, gentle tooth extractions under anesthesia, and long-term management of oncology and feline thyroid conditions. Clients value that the clinic integrates conventional medicine with holistic options like traditional Chinese medicine.

q.en: Does Langara Veterinary Hospital offer holistic treatment options?

a.en: Yes, Dr. Vivian Leung provides integrative care including Traditional Chinese Medicine alongside conventional veterinary therapies.

q.en: Is the clinic available on weekends for patient visits?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that Dr. Leung and her team are available to care for patients on weekends, including Sundays.

q.en: Can the hospital handle international pet travel paperwork?

a.en: Yes, clients confirm that the clinic provides comprehensive assistance with export documentation and travel health certificates.

q.en: Are treatment costs and estimates explained in advance?

a.en: Yes, pet owners appreciate that pricing is transparent and reasonable, with procedures and options detailed before treatment.
